evidence.author: raj
evidence.quote: TOML can be read with tomllib, which is in the standard library from Python 3.11, and pyproject.toml is where Python tools keep settings now.

evidence.author: maya
evidence.quote: Decision: we will read a [tool.quillfmt] table from pyproject.toml using tomllib, with tomli on older Pythons. YAML is rejected because of the implicit typing surprises and the extra dependency. INI is rejected because it cannot express nes
